card.name: Evening and dinner meal words
card.fires_on: The words evening and dinner (also dinners), mostly at the end of a clause about the day's evening meal or plans. Also fires weakly on "every" in dosing intervals.

modes.label: Evening in dose-skip advice
modes.description: The word evening right after "that" in advice to skip a dose on a day with alcohol.
modes.example: Patients who drink three or more standard alcoholic drinks should skip their ADDYI dose that<< evening>>.

modes.label: Dinner as a meal
modes.description: The word dinner ending a phrase about cooking, sharing or hosting a meal.
modes.example: Join or host a potluck<< dinner>>.

modes.label: Every in dosing intervals
modes.description: The word every before an hours interval in a dose instruction.
modes.example: It should not be less than 0.5 mg per kg<< every>> 24 hours.

card.plain: It lights up on evening and dinner words, especially a closing "that evening" or a dinner event.
